one_liner: Commerce platform with APIs for apps, storefronts, and checkout.

evidence.claim: OAuth 2.0 is the standard authorization protocol; token exchange, authorization code grant, and client credentials grant flows are supported
evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0 is the industry-standard protocol for authorizing or giving permissions to apps.

evidence.claim: Self-serve credentials: admin-created custom apps generate API credentials/access tokens directly in the Shopify admin
evidence.quote: you or the app user needs to install the app from the Shopify admin to generate API credentials and the necessary

evidence.claim: Broad API surface: GraphQL Admin API, REST Admin API (legacy), Storefront API, webhooks, Partner API, and more
evidence.quote: Graph QL Admin API ... REST Admin API (legacy) ... Storefront API ... Partner API

evidence.claim: Shopify officially documents a Storefront MCP server for AI agents on its own docs site
evidence.quote: The Storefront MCP server lets your AI agent handle shopping tasks for the selected store

evidence.claim: Session tokens are used to authenticate incoming requests for apps rendered in the Shopify admin
evidence.quote: Apps rendered in the Shopify admin need to authenticate their incoming requests with [session tokens]

notes: REST Admin API is marked legacy in favor of the GraphQL Admin API. Shopify also lists 'Web MCP Tools' and an 'Agents' docs section (UCP), signaling strong agent-facing investment. Admin-created custom apps yield tokens instantly; public app distribution requires App Store review.
